We have to understand the laws as it pertains to sex and marriage and understand the difference between the two. This is a major part of the issue as it pertains to: is sex marriage? Does me having sex, does that mean I'm married? ## Scriptures Opened **[Jeremiah 17:4](/bible/jeremiah/17#v4)** *[[1:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=apIxJfQ88bI&t=98s)]* > [4](/bible/jeremiah/17#v4) And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever. - And thou, even thyself: thou Jeremiah, even yourself. - Shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee: God said, Jeremiah, you and the rest of Israel, you are going to discontinue from your heritage that I gave you. - And I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: so, how are we going to be discontinued or disconnected or disassociated from our heritage? By going into captivity, by going into slavery in a land that did not belong to us. So, in us returning to our God and returning to our laws, the Lord is opening up our understanding as it pertains to our heritage. We're going to deal specifically with marriage and sex.
